title: Initial configuration of the copying machine
statement: Let $E$ and $G$ be finite-state Boolean machines, let $e_0,e_1$ be states of $E$ and $g_0,g_1$ states of $G$, and suppose $E$ has at least one work tape. For every Boolean input $x$, the initial configuration of the machine built from these data equals the copy configuration for the empty copied prefix, with the copying head at position zero.
hypotheses_covered: The machine $E$ has at least one work tape
